decisive_items: an abnormally low transverse colon and right colic flexure
an abnormal superior mesenteric artery–vein relationship, with the vein coursing to the left of the artery
response.rationale: The imaging findings of abnormal colon position and SMA-SMV inversion are pathognomonic for intestinal malrotation, while the appendix is normal, excluding appendicitis. Volvulus is less supported because there is no ischemia.

rejected.why: Lacks ischemia and the clustered loops are better explained by malrotation; no twisting evidence.
Appendix is explicitly normal, contradicting acute appendicitis.
